quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #13
										  					
  

33 Questions • Passing Score 27

questions.question: Your blind spot is the area of the road that:

options.text: You cannot see without turning your head.
Is directly behind your vehicle.
You can see in your rearview mirror.
You can see in your side mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: You cannot see without turning your head.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas you cannot see without turning your head. They are on the sides and behind your vehicle.

questions.question: Distracted driving is:

options.text: Very uncommon.
Extremely dangerous.
Nothing to worry about.
Just as safe as normal driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Extremely dangerous.
questions.explanation: Distracted driving is extremely dangerous. It puts you, your passengers, pedestrians, and other drivers at risk. Paying full attention to the road helps prevent crashes.

questions.question: When you hear a fire engine siren behind you, you must:

options.text: Slow down until it passes you.
Turn on your flashers.
Pull over to the side of the road and stop.
Speed up and take the nearest exit.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over to the side of the road and stop.
questions.explanation: When you hear an emergency vehicle siren, pull over to the side of the road and stop.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic light works the same way as:

options.text: A slow sign.
A yield sign.
A stop sign.
An intersection sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: A stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must stop and let all other traffic go first.

questions.question: When a vehicle with Anti-Lock Brakes loses grip on a slippery road, drivers should:

options.text: Pump the brakes.
Press and hold the brake pedal down.
Press and hold the gas pedal.
Lightly tap the brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Press and hold the brake pedal down.
questions.explanation: If you lose traction on a slippery road, press hard on the brake pedal, hold it down, and steer to safety. The Anti-Lock Braking System will pump the brakes automatically. Letting up on the brakes or pumping them yourself will turn off the system.

questions.question: Highway signs that tell drivers about dangerous road conditions are called:

options.text: Regulatory signs.
Warning signs.
Information signs.
Guide signs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warning signs.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. Follow these signs for your safety. Ignoring them can cause accidents.

questions.question: You are driving up a hill behind a heavy truck. You should know that:

options.text: The truck may be going slower than the speed limit.
You may not be able to safely pass the truck.
You may not be able to legally pass the truck.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Large trucks often go slower than the speed limit, especially on hills. Be careful when approaching from behind. On hills with limited visibility, passing is illegal.

questions.question: When a traffic light turns green, you should:

options.text: Let pedestrians go first.
Speed up as fast as you can.
Back up slowly.
Wait for another driver to wave you on.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let pedestrians go first.
questions.explanation: A green light means you can go through the intersection. But first, let pedestrians and any other traffic still in the intersection pass safely.

questions.question: When is it illegal to drive below the speed limit?

options.text: When driving slowly disrupts normal traffic flow.
When in heavy traffic in a construction zone.
Only when driving in rural areas.
When driving in bad weather.

questions.correctAnswerText: When driving slowly disrupts normal traffic flow.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive so slowly that you block the normal flow of traffic. You can get a ticket for this.

questions.question: A flashing yellow light at an intersection means you should:

options.text: Slow down and move forward carefully.
Continue through the intersection normally.
Stop and wait for a green light.
Stop and go when the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and move forward carefully.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means caution. Slow down, look both ways, and proceed with care.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow line on your side of the centerline mean?

options.text: Slow down.
Pass with caution.
Do not pass.
Keep right on hills.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not pass.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line on your side means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: When parking downhill on a two-way street, what should you do?

options.text: Turn your wheels to the right.
Turn your wheels to the left.
Keep your wheels pointed straight ahead.
Leave your transmission in neutral.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your wheels to the right.
questions.explanation: Turn your wheels toward the curb when parking downhill. If your car rolls, it will roll away from traffic.

questions.question: What does a steady yellow light mean?

options.text: Go.
Yield to other cars.
Slow down and prepare to stop.
Stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and prepare to stop.
questions.explanation: A yellow light warns you that a red light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop. If you are already in the intersection, you can continue through carefully.

questions.question: What should you do when entering a roadway from a private driveway?

options.text: Blow your horn to warn other drivers.
Stop with part of your car on the roadway to alert other drivers.
Drive out fast to merge smoothly with traffic.
Yield to pedestrians and traffic on the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to pedestrians and traffic on the roadway.
questions.explanation: You must yield to pedestrians and traffic when entering a roadway from a private driveway.

questions.question: What does a flashing red light mean?

options.text: The same thing as a stop sign.
The traffic signal is broken.
You do not have to come to a complete stop.
Driving conditions are dangerous.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same thing as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop completely. Yield to other traffic and pedestrians, then proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: Why is it important to keep space between your vehicle and others?

options.text: Prevents distractions from other vehicles.
Allows you time to react to unexpected situations.
Keeps traffic flowing at a safe pace.
Keeps other drivers alert.

questions.correctAnswerText: Allows you time to react to unexpected situations.
questions.explanation: Space between vehicles gives you time to respond if other drivers make mistakes.

questions.question: When driving in fog, what should you do?

options.text: Drive cautiously and reduce your speed.
Do not use your high beam headlights.
Use low beam headlights to better see the road.
All of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: In fog, slow down and drive with caution. Use low beams instead of high beams. High beams reflect off fog and make it harder to see.

questions.question: What is defensive driving?

options.text: Spotting dangerous situations and taking action to avoid accidents.
Getting ahead of poor drivers in traffic.
Following the vehicle ahead at a close distance.
Quickly changing lanes to avoid traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spotting dangerous situations and taking action to avoid accidents.
questions.explanation: Defensive driving means identifying hazards and acting before an accident happens. It protects you from careless, aggressive, or reckless drivers.

questions.question: When parking uphill next to a curb, what should you do?

options.text: Keep the rear tires against the curb.
Keep the front tires straight ahead.
Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
Turn your steering wheel toward the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Turn your wheels away from the curb when parking uphill. If your car rolls, it will roll into the curb and stop.

questions.question: Is it legal to cross a double solid yellow line to pass?

options.text: Yes.
No.
If there is no oncoming traffic.
If the vehicle ahead is driving under the speed limit.

questions.correctAnswerText: No.
questions.explanation: You cannot cross double yellow lines to pass. You can only cross them to turn into a driveway or business entrance.

questions.question: You should drive below the posted speed limit when:

options.text: Road or weather conditions are not perfect.
You see a police car.
You are entering a highway with other cars.
You are on a four-lane road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road or weather conditions are not perfect.
questions.explanation: When roads are wet or slippery, when you cannot see well, or when any condition is not perfect, drive below the speed limit. Even when driving at the speed limit, you can be ticketed if you are driving too fast for the conditions.

questions.question: At dusk or on overcast days, you should:

options.text: Use your four-way flashers.
Use your parking lights.
Not turn on any vehicle lights.
Turn on your headlights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on your headlights.
questions.explanation: At dusk or on overcast days, turn on your headlights. Use low beam headlights when you are within 1,000 feet of an approaching vehicle and within 500 feet of a vehicle you are following. Always use low beams in poor weather.

questions.question: A driver can legally pass on the right side of another vehicle:

options.text: If the vehicle is waiting to turn left and there is a passing lane available.
Even if it means driving off the pavement.
On a narrow bridge.
At any time.

questions.correctAnswerText: If the vehicle is waiting to turn left and there is a passing lane available.
questions.explanation: You may pass on the right if there is a passing lane available and the vehicle is turning left or waiting to turn left. You may also pass on the right on a multilane road with two or more lanes going the same direction. Never drive off the pavement to pass another vehicle.

questions.question: When driving in rain, you must:

options.text: Use low beam headlights.
Use high beam headlights.
Use parking lights.
Use no lights.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: In rain, use your low beam headlights.

questions.question: You are driving on a divided multilane highway and see or hear an emergency vehicle signal. You should:

options.text: Ignore the signal if other lanes are available for the emergency vehicle.
Stop as quickly as possible.
Slow down, move to give the emergency vehicle a clear path, and stop.
Speed up to get out of the way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, move to give the emergency vehicle a clear path, and stop.
questions.explanation: When you hear a siren or see flashing lights, slow down, give the emergency vehicle a clear path, and stop. Do not try to drive faster than the emergency vehicle.

questions.question: You may pass another vehicle:

options.text: In a curve or on a hill because oncoming traffic is unlikely.
By using the shoulder of the highway.
If your lane has a solid yellow line and the passing lane is clear.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: None of the above.
questions.explanation: Never pass on a hill or in a curve because you cannot see oncoming traffic and may cause a crash. Never pass by driving on the highway shoulder. Never pass by crossing a solid yellow line.

questions.question: Before passing another vehicle, you should signal:

options.text: Just before changing lanes.
At any time.
After changing lanes.
Early enough so others know your plans.

questions.correctAnswerText: Early enough so others know your plans.
questions.explanation: Signal early before passing so other drivers know what you plan to do.

questions.question: A double solid yellow line in the center of a two-lane road means:

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions and drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions and drivers can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction and drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction and drivers can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in opposite directions and drivers cannot pass.
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. Solid lines mean drivers cannot pass.

questions.question: Drivers must yield to a pedestrian:

options.text: Even if the pedestrian crosses carelessly.
Only when the pedestrian is in a crosswalk.
Only if the pedestrian is on the same side of the road.
If the pedestrian uses a hand signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Even if the pedestrian crosses carelessly.
questions.explanation: Drivers must always yield to pedestrians in the street, even if they cross against a red light or cross carelessly.

questions.question: The most effective safety restraints in a crash are:

options.text: Only a lap and shoulder belt.
Only an airbag.
Both a lap/shoulder belt and an airbag.
No safety restraints.

questions.correctAnswerText: Both a lap/shoulder belt and an airbag.
questions.explanation: Safety belts double your chance of surviving a crash and greatly reduce serious injuries. Airbags with safety belts provide extra protection in front-end crashes. Wear both shoulder and lap belts.

questions.question: What is a good rule for passing other vehicles?

options.text: Always pass on the right.
Drive with traffic flow and pass only when needed.
Move to the front of slow traffic to see better ahead.
Always flash lights and honk to alert other drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive with traffic flow and pass only when needed.
questions.explanation: Passing other vehicles increases collision risk. If you drive faster than nearby traffic, you will keep passing others. Instead, drive at the same speed as traffic around you, follow the speed limit, and pass only when necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn.
No U-turns.
No exit.
No right turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: School ahead.
School crossing.
Pedestrian crossing.
Construction workers on or near the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pedestrian crossing.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black letters on a yellow background. They warn drivers of dangers ahead. This sign tells you that people may cross the road in this area.
